source.provenance: Production simulator → WebSocket bridge → real Kotlin CLI; prior recorded smoke, not hardware.

limitations.truthM: Nearest distance in the single sensor cone only (up to 4 m); not truth for all visible objects.
limitations.sensor: One simulated 18-degree ToF zone; nominal white-target range up to 1.2 m. NO_TARGET does not mean clear path.
limitations.export: Not an ADT/VRS export, hardware recording, or validated safety metric.
